components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Cinema Red solid action button with 4px physical offset shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0A0A0A; color: #DC2626; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; border: 2px solid #0A0A0A; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px #0A0A0A; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #DC2626; color: #FFFFFF; transform: translate(-2px, -2px); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0px #0A0A0A; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translate(1px, 1px); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px #0A0A0A; }

components.name: Accent Marquee Button
components.description: Velvet red button for shuffle, matching, and rating actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { background: #DC2626; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 10px 18px; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; border: 2px solid #0A0A0A; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px #0A0A0A; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: #B91C1C; transform: translate(-2px, -2px); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0px #0A0A0A; }

components.name: Genre Stamp Badge
components.description: Solid inked fanzine stamp displaying the movie's primary genre.
components.css: .ds-stamp-badge { display: inline-block; background: #0A0A0A; color: #EF4444; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: var(--font-geist-mono), monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; border: 1px solid #0A0A0A; box-shadow: 1px 1px 0px #000000; }

narrative.northStar: Gece Gösterimi — 35mm Analog Fanzin & Velvet Cinema Red
narrative.overview: izledin.com (EST. '26) is built around the raw, tactile aesthetic of independent cinema fanzines, 35mm film negatives, dark cinema marquees, and typewriter review logs. The interface purposefully rejects generic AI web tropes in favor of physical offset drop-shadows, stamped verification tags, and authentic typewriter annotations.
keyCharacteristics: Tactile Materiality: Physical offset ink drop-shadows and 35mm film perforations.
Dual Typographic Soul: Bold Geist Sans headlines paired with archival Geist Mono data details.
High-Contrast Legibility: High density layout with clear contrast between pure obsidian (#0A0A0A) and clean white canvas (#FAFAFA/#FFFFFF).

rules.name: The Hard-Ink Rule
rules.body: All borders, dividers, and offset drop shadows must use solid Ink (#0A0A0A in light / #404040 in dark). Soft blurred gradients or grey semi-transparent borders are prohibited.

rules.name: The Editorial Title Rule
rules.body: All major headings, button labels, and genre tags are strictly uppercase. Monospaced type is reserved for data fields, code stamps, and typewriter diary logs.

rules.name: The Hard-Edge Elevation Rule
rules.body: No Gaussian blurs or shadow-lg soft drop-shadows. Every surface is physically grounded by a solid pitch-black offset shadow.

dos: Do use solid hard offset shadows (4px 4px 0px var(--hard-shadow)) for all cards and buttons.
Do display the actual primary genre on media card stamp badges (e.g. KORKU, BİLİM KURGU, SANAT & FESTİVAL).
Do keep headings in bold Geist Sans and timestamps/badges in Geist Mono.
Do maintain responsive grids with 12 items default and '+12 Daha Fazla Göster' expansion.
donts: Don't use purple or violet accents on dark backgrounds (Forbidden AI Trope).
Don't use soft blurred glow filters, glassmorphism, or gradient text.
Don't use round pill buttons or floating bubbly shapes.
Don't add font-mono to root containers which distorts global header navigation.
